newsitem.title: CANADA: Thompson, Nissho to buy Placer mine.
newsitem.headline: Thompson, Nissho to buy Placer mine.

text.p: Placer Dome Inc said it had signed a letter of intent to sell its Endako molybdenum mine in British Columbia to Thompson Creek Mining Co of Denver and Toyko-based Nissho Iwai Corp.
Details of the deal were not disclosed.
Placer, in a statement released late Thursday, said the companies plan to close the sale on May 30.
After the sale, Thompson will own 75 percent and operate the mine. Nissho Iwai will own 25 percent.
"The sale is part of the corporation's strategy to sharpen its focus on core gold assets," Vancouver-based Placer said.
The Endako mine is one of the world's largest producers of the mineral molybdenum, used in the production of steel. ((--Toronto Bureau (416) 941-8109))
